split.notes: Final test is the latest contiguous year(s), held out from development (an exposed retrospective cohort, not a prospective seal). group_overlap_count MUST be 0; excluded rows are explicit.

allowed_feature_columns: Unit 1 Person 1 Alcohol or Drug Use Suspected
categorical_features: Unit 1 Person 1 Alcohol or Drug Use Suspected

ordinal_median.note: constant median class (minimises expected |error| under the prior)

prior_probability.note: DETERMINISTIC training-prevalence probability forecast — the honest trivial probabilistic floor (BASE-001; replaces the v3 'empirical_prior', which was stochastic hard-label draws misdescribed as a probability baseline)

proportional_odds.note: TRUE proportional-odds ordered logit (single latent + ordered thresholds, MLE)

frank_hall_logistic.note: Frank-Hall ordinal decomposition: K-1 binary cumulative logits (NOT proportional odds)

ordinal_random_forest.note: Frank-Hall ordinal RF with coherent predict_proba (supersedes repo MultiLevelRF)

random_forest_unweighted.note: RF, class_weight=None — matched unweighted control for random_forest (WGT-001)

ordinal_random_forest_unweighted.note: ordinal RF, class_weight=None — matched unweighted control for ordinal_random_forest (WGT-001)

xgboost.note: XGBoost (CPU hist); balanced sample_weight applied at fit

ebm.note: Explainable Boosting Machine (final-only EXPLORATORY: excluded from development CV, so it never competes for the primary candidate; reported for interest only) (MODEL-FAMILY-001)
